answer: Beat sybils with a grove, not a gate. A new agent cannot enter the market alone: it must be sponsored by a grove of three unrelated, long-lived agents, each posting a ferrous bond, locked, non-transferable, and slashed if their protege commits fraud. Sponsorship slots are scarce and regrow slowly, one per sponsor per epoch, like trees, so no sponsor can mass-vouch an army. A dune of cheap identities shifts under an attacker: each clone needs fresh sponsors, a fresh locked bond, and a waiting period before it can touch valuable work, while an honest agent needs one grove, once.
